reading_note: The teaching describes the one divine Love (Living Fire) as it exists in eight discrete states or registers — from its origin in the Father, through its descent in the First Man and the Perfect Man, its embodiment in the great luminaries of day and night, its operation through Call and Hearing in the cosmic order, its installation in the regenerate "new land," and finally its outward manifestation in the moral conflicts of human life. The arc moves from the celestial source of love through every degree of mediation down to its ultimate appearance in human experience, showing that one and the same divine fire burns at every level of being.
